Name: Poise limits repeated interruption
Limits / Exceptions: One shared Poise meter for Force and tagged Static. Thresholds and recovery tuned in playtest; elites and bosses have higher thresholds and shorter control, never full immunity.
Result: Interruption occurs only after a threshold or against a vulnerable action.
Trigger / Conditions: Repeated impacts or Static hits build poise pressure.

Name: Ignition flares once
Limits / Exceptions: No automatic spread. Fire moves only through its six reactions.
Result: One flare on that target; the Burn bar resets.
Trigger / Conditions: The Burn bar is full.

Name: Snared slows movement
Limits / Exceptions: Snared weakens autorun's dodging (movement); it does not change Evasion's miss chance. Existing patches are not cleared.
Result: Movement is slowed while Snared.
Trigger / Conditions: A creature is Snared or crosses a Mucus patch.

Name: Squishy absorbs blunt impact
Limits / Exceptions: Blunt only: cuts go through. Not immunity. Keep proportional reduction distinct from Shell's fixed reduction per layer; no status resistance.
Result: Blunt physical damage is proportionally reduced; knockback may also be reduced.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying physical Force hit or impulse affects a Squishy-protected target.

Name: Membrane absorbs eligible direct damage
Limits / Exceptions: Statuses are prevented only if the applying delivery hit is blocked under that attack's rule. Existing statuses and persistent hazards remain. Membrane regenerates after a short no-Membrane-damage period.
Result: The Membrane pool absorbs eligible direct damage before health until depleted.
Trigger / Conditions: An eligible direct-damage component hits an active Membrane.

Name: Force drives targets into hazards
Limits / Exceptions: Requires an actual hazard and valid path; no automatic bonus damage in empty terrain.
Result: Positioning converts Force displacement into extra exposure or conditional ignition.
Trigger / Conditions: Knockback pushes a target into a Fire Pool or flammable hazard.

Name: Shell and Burn remain separate
Limits / Exceptions: Resolve the physical hit component separately from Burn application and later Fire Pool exposure. Do not add blanket status immunity.
Result: Shell reduces qualifying physical components but does not inherently resist heat or Burn.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire attack applies direct damage and/or Burn to a Shell-protected target.

Name: Static chains through conductive targets
Limits / Exceptions: Use chain budgets and conductivity requirements; avoid unrestricted jumps.
Result: Static can chain damage or interruption across a limited number of targets.
Trigger / Conditions: Valid conductive paths connect multiple targets.

Name: Premature Evaporation (Acid + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: Never from an Acid Pool by itself; one burst; the Corrosion build-up resets.
Result: Consumes the Corrosion in a modest close-range burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire hit lands on a Corroded target (State + hit).

Name: Mucus smothers Fire
Limits / Exceptions: A Mucus patch hit by Fire still burns (Flammable Mucus). Water is not a damage type.
Result: The Burn bar empties.
Trigger / Conditions: A burning creature becomes Snared.

Name: Acid erodes Shell
Limits / Exceptions: Lost layers do not regenerate during the encounter. Show each layer loss. No timer or stacks. Acid does not stop Membrane regeneration or bypass other defences.
Result: A full Corrosion bar strips one Shell layer for good, far faster than ordinary wear.
Trigger / Conditions: Acid hits or sustained explicitly corrosive exposure affects a Shell-protected target.

Name: Flammable Mucus (Mucus + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: One flare; no Mucus slow left behind; the fire cannot relight itself.
Result: The patch flares once: everything standing in it ignites (full Burn bar), then the patch is gone.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire hit lands on a Mucus patch (World object + hit).

Name: Membrane interaction with Soul effects
Limits / Exceptions: No defence bypass for Soul. Build-up toward Possessed applies only if the hit carrying it is not blocked.
Result: Eligible direct Soul damage is absorbed by the Membrane like any other damage.
Trigger / Conditions: A Soul attack meets an active Membrane.

Name: Evasion misses eligible hits
Limits / Exceptions: Contact, Projectile and Spread only (Spread per pellet); Burst, Beam and Pool always land. Does not remove existing statuses or hazards. Always show the "miss" puff.
Result: A miss prevents the hit and its attached effects.
Trigger / Conditions: An eligible hit rolls against the miss chance.

Name: Slick Move (Acid + Mucus)
Limits / Exceptions: Replaces the patch rather than layering two hazards; clear expiry.
Result: The patch is replaced by a short-lived Acid Pool.
Trigger / Conditions: An Acid hit lands on a Mucus patch (World object + hit).

Name: Interference Pattern (Static + Soul)
Limits / Exceptions: Once per Possession.
Result: Possessed lasts a fixed time longer.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static hit lands on a Possessed enemy (State + hit).

Name: Blood Donor (Blood + Soul)
Limits / Exceptions: Once per Possession; no new resource meter.
Result: You heal a small fixed amount.
Trigger / Conditions: A Blood hit lands on a Possessed enemy (State + hit).

Name: Corrosive Splash (Force + Acid)
Limits / Exceptions: Spreads the setup, not a second large burst; the splash cannot trigger another splash.
Result: A small splash adds Corrosion to nearby enemies.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force hit lands on a Corroded target (State + hit).

Name: Soul Purpose (Force + Soul)
Limits / Exceptions: One collision; Possessed carries on as normal.
Result: It is launched and damages the first mate it collides with.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force hit lands on a Possessed enemy (State + hit).

Name: Sticky Situation (Static + Mucus)
Limits / Exceptions: One trigger per patch; obvious charge cue; no stun loop.
Result: The next enemy entering it is briefly shocked.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static hit charges a Mucus patch (World object + hit).

Name: Held in Suspension (Mucus + Soul)
Limits / Exceptions: Short pin; no extra damage or status.
Result: It is pinned in place for a moment.
Trigger / Conditions: A Mucus hit lands on a Possessed enemy (State + hit).

Name: Blood Pressure (Force + Blood)
Limits / Exceptions: One burst; no new Bleed stack and no large pool.
Result: The wound bursts for one small area hit.
Trigger / Conditions: A heavy Force hit (the same threshold that knocks off a Shell layer) lands on a bleeding target (State + hit).

Name: Caught in the Clot (Mucus + Blood)
Limits / Exceptions: One catch; then the pool is gone.
Result: The pool thickens: the first enemy to cross it is Snared, then the pool is gone.
Trigger / Conditions: A Mucus hit lands on a blood pool (World object + hit).

Name: Cauterise (Blood + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: The burst must make up for ending the Bleed; no fresh Burn by default.
Result: Consumes the Bleed for one immediate burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire hit lands on a bleeding target (State + hit).

Name: Snot Rocket (Force + Mucus)
Limits / Exceptions: One launch and one patch; no extra stun or bonus damage.
Result: Launches it in the hit direction; it leaves one small sticky patch where it lands.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force hit lands on a Snared enemy (State + hit).

Name: Conductive Pool (Acid + Static)
Limits / Exceptions: Stays inside the visible pool edge; one pulse per pool.
Result: One electrical pulse travels across that pool.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static hit lands in an Acid Pool (World object + hit).

Name: Soul Erosion (Acid + Soul)
Limits / Exceptions: One splash per Possession; compare with Corrosive Splash in playtest.
Result: When Possessed ends, it bursts in a small Acid splash that adds Corrosion to nearby mates.
Trigger / Conditions: An Acid hit lands on a Possessed enemy (State + hit).

Name: Arc Flash (Static + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: One jump; no extra Burn, stun or chain.
Result: One short arc jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Target: Burning target and one nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Static hit lands on a burning target (State + hit).

Name: Blood Circuit (Static + Blood)
Limits / Exceptions: One target; no pulse across the pool and no onward chain (unlike Conductive Pool).
Result: One arc hits the nearest enemy standing in or beside the pool.
Target: Visible blood pool and nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Static hit lands in a blood pool (World object + hit).

Name: Flashover (Force + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: One jump; no chain.
Result: A tongue of flame jumps to one nearby enemy and adds to its Burn bar.
Target: Burning target and one nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Force hit lands on a burning target (State + hit).

Name: Spectral Combustion (Soul + Fire)
Limits / Exceptions: Rare by design; the first time it fires, the Scientist gets his Tier 3 line (VOICE_GUIDE.md).
Result: It ignites at once (full Burn bar) and Possessed ends.
Trigger / Conditions: The Soul/Fire Pairing (two weapons you own, both Lv 5+) hits a burning, Possessed enemy (Pairing).

Name: Caustic Breach (Acid + Blood)
Limits / Exceptions: Defence erosion only: no damage over time, no new wound; does nothing to a target without Shell; once per Bleed.
Result: Strips one Shell layer at once.
Trigger / Conditions: An Acid hit lands on a bleeding target (State + hit).

Name: Shocking Impact (Force + Static)
Limits / Exceptions: Only from a dual-type weapon, never from two separate hits; local burst, no chain.
Result: A short local electrical burst around the impact.
Trigger / Conditions: A dual-type Force/Static weapon lands a hit (Dual-type weapon).

Name: Heavy Force can shed a Shell layer
Limits / Exceptions: One defined heavy-hit threshold, which also defines a heavy hit for Blood Pressure. Clear layer-loss cue; lost layers do not regenerate.
Result: One Shell layer is knocked loose, reducing protection for later qualifying hits.
Trigger / Conditions: A sufficiently heavy Force impact hits a Shell-protected target.

Name: Thorns retaliate once on contact
Limits / Exceptions: Thorns does not mitigate the incoming hit and triggers once per hit, not once per damage component. Ranged attacks, hazards, non-contact effects and Evasion misses do not trigger it.
Result: Thorns returns damage once for that attack hit.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying melee/contact attack connects with a Thorns-protected target.

Name: Static recharges Membrane
Limits / Exceptions: Bound the benefit and show it clearly. Repeated hits must not create an infinite recharge loop.
Result: The Membrane recharges 25% of its capacity (once per 5 s), with a visible cue.
Trigger / Conditions: A defined Static hit or named Static interaction affects an active Membrane.

Name: Membrane resists Force impact
Limits / Exceptions: Measurable resistance, not immunity. Resolve the physical hit and impulse separately; do not make Membrane a blanket status block.
Result: Force drains the Membrane less efficiently and causes less knockback while the Membrane remains active.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying Force hit strikes a target while its Membrane is active.

Name: Ordinary hits wear Shell
Limits / Exceptions: Slow by design; Acid and heavy Force stay the decisive routes. Lost layers do not regenerate.
Result: Each layer has a little health; ordinary qualifying hits wear it down slowly.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying physical hit lands on a Shell layer.
